mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees with clear skies by City Hall and a waxing gibbous moon overhead.

The city has announced that fall leaf pickup begins on October 5, requiring residents to place loose leaves behind the curb. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several development projects including work at 2681 Country View Court and the Liberty Business Park.
Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, and tomorrow is packed with excitement including Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park and live music at various local venues.
On September 3, a 33-year-old man was arrested for a second offence O W I after crashing his vehicle in the 700 block of Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, but they will open today at 10:00 AM to serve the community.
